messages:
Lina: Reminder - NimbusHealth renewal demo Fri 9:30am PT. Drafting a tight preflight (10m) focused on warmup, quick latency checks, and the customer fallback script.

Marco: Love it. Can we include an ultra-quick warmup that primes KV cache and batch lanes with 6 calls?

Jae: Yep. Proposed 10m runbook to paste into invite:
1) Goal (30s) - align on availability + answer-stability.
2) Warmup (2m) - POST 6 curated prompts (3 short, 3 long).
3) Latency check (2m) - run probe script for p50/p95/p99.
4) Failover demo (3m) - show canary toggle -> smaller-model fallback and note quality tradeoffs.
5) Close (1.5m) - capture feedback and owners.

Marco: Probe one-liner for the call:
```bash
python tools/latency_probe.py --tenant nimbus --model open-7b --n 20
```
Outputs p50/p95/p99 and kv-cache-hit%.

Lina: Customer-facing fallback blurb to paste under demo notes: "If we detect persistent latency above threshold, we'll switch to a lower-latency model variant to keep the service responsive. This may slightly affect wording; we'll log any regressions and follow up with recommended prompt adjustments."

svc-bot: [deploy] Nimbus canary: last deploy 2026-01-29T12:02:00Z. No incidents.

Jae: Action items: Marco - attach warmup prompts + token estimate. Lina - add runbook to invite and share fallback blurb. I'll rehearse the canary toggle in staging.

Marco: Uploaded prompts and token estimates: https://docs.redwood.example/d/nimbus-warmup

Lina: Thanks all, adding to invite now. See you Fri. :thumbsup:
